problem: Production commercial runtime had canonical v1 orchestration but retained legacy v2-v6 function bodies, historical terminal actions without explicit lifecycle lineage, repository drift versus the applied Supabase state, and the delivery candidate initially lacked the mandatory same-lineage writeback artifacts.
root_cause: runtime evolution created compatibility versions without a permanent alias-only regression invariant
terminal action lifecycle and observed business outcomes were conflated in assurance
production migration state could advance before repository writeback became terminal
material delivery was initially proposed without all mandatory learning, ledger and human-readable closure evidence being part of the changed-path set
decision: Use one canonical commercial loop owner, turn legacy versions into aliases, enforce explicit terminal lineage without synthesising business outcomes, keep unresolved observed-outcome obligations open, and fail closed unless the same delivery lineage contains all mandatory writeback evidence.

prevention.rule: Every material Powerhouse candidate must include canonical Brain learning, an activity/development ledger event and human-readable change/learning documentation in the exact candidate scope before merge readiness.
prevention.regression_contract: Required test remains fail-closed for missing writeback evidence; observed commercial outcomes may only close from real evidence and open obligations must stay explicit.

historical_replay.reason: mandatory same-lineage writeback artifacts were incomplete

outcome: One loop, one owner and one lineage remain canonical; delivery now also carries mandatory learning, ledger and human-readable closure evidence without fabricating external outcomes.
next_decision_rule: Any future change that creates a second full-loop scheduler owner, independent legacy loop logic, a terminal action without lineage, fabricated observed outcomes, or a material candidate without closure artifacts must fail CI before terminal completion can be claimed.
